title: SBM Credilio Novio Rupay (FD) credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: SBM (State Bank of Mauritius) has partnered with Credilio (Rupay) to provide customers with easy access to credit options. Through this collaboration, SBM users can enjoy flexible and instant financing for their purchases, powered by the secure and widely accepted Rupay payment platform.
